Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
characterization

Collect single-crystal diffraction data

Collect data on the sealed crystal at 294 K using a CAD4/Turbo diffractometer, rotating-anode source and graphite-monochromated Mo radiation. The Table 1 acquisition settings are retained as separate typed values. A ψ-scan absorption correction was tested but was not used in the adopted refinement. The scan is ω–2θ at 0.5 degree 2θ/min, with width 0.51 + 0.61 tan θ degrees. Three monitoring reflections are checked every 3 h; background at each scan endpoint is counted for half the scan time.

Unresolved information

  • The prose and Table 1 disagree on dehydration temperatures/durations and indium-contact duration. Neither version is selected as a resolved recipe.
  • Absolute host and indium amounts, capillary dimensions, feed-flow rate, indium/crystal temperature difference, redox vacuum, gas amount/flow, final vacuum and cooling rate are unreported.
  • Nominal Si100Al92 differs from the averaged Table 2 model containing 96 Si and 96 Al; fixed and varied occupancies are refinement parameters.
  • Average disorder, fractional site populations and charge-compensation hypotheses do not specify a unique atomistic specimen or a DFT-ready structure.
  • A curator reconstruction of the reported average positions and occupancies is qualified for source interpretation. It omits unresolved ADPs, preserves mixed and alternative sites, and is not a full refinement, ordered DFT model or exact-structure training label. Two SI signs remain unresolved.
  • The approximately 4300 Å XPS depth statement cannot be reconstructed from the displayed approximately 10 s sputter cycles and reported rate.
  • The input Na-X synthesis and cited control preparations are external references, not complete procedures supplied here.

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • Experimental prose: initial/redehydration623K48h1e-6Torr; In contact623K96 h. Table 1: dehydrations673K3 days; In contact623K5 days. Unresolved same-study conflicts, not approved alternative protocols.
  • Table 2 footnotec models96Si+96Al, while nominal In66Si100Al92O384 framework and text use100Si92Al. Preserve refinement representation and nominal composition separately.
  • Cluster charge7+ and local In1.75+/ca2+ are proposed; total83+versusframework92- motivates unverified oxygen-loss4.5/unitcell or9H+/unitcell alternatives. Never add those atoms/defects to measured coordinate model.
  • Figure 1B In87-X spectrum copied fromreference 34. Figure 2A Inmetal intensity scaled percaption1/20. ProductXPS versus reactant/reference must remain separate.
  • Figure 3 caption says0.6Å/s and~10 s sputtering after each measurement, while prose says depth~4300Å. Printed depth not derivable from shown20-ishcycles; do not invent total sputtering schedule.
  • Table 1 data/parameter ratios17.1/18.3 correspond observed reflections754/44 and1207/66, although heading labelsm/s withm=allunique1209/2032. Preserve printed table and flag definition mismatch.
  • Heo subsectionc heading sayssitesIprimeandIIprime but body/finaltable placesInIIa atsiteII; use exactatomlabels and preserve heading discrepancy.
